We are looking for a motivated and analytical Trainee Actuarial Analyst to join our Risk Consulting & Analytics Solutions team in London. This is an entry-level role for someone at the start of their actuarial career.
In this role, you will work with a variety of clients across Marsh Specialty. You will help our teams use data, models, and actuarial techniques to understand and manage insurance and risk challenges.
This is a great opportunity to develop your technical and consulting skills while working with experienced colleagues across Marsh. You will gain exposure to model development, client projects, presentations, and different areas of commercial insurance.
This is a hybrid role, with a requirement to work in the office at least three days a week.
We will rely on you to:
Support the delivery of analytics and actuarial projects for clients
Help prepare analysis, reports, presentations, and other project materials
Explain analytical methods and results clearly to colleagues and clients
Support recommendations that help clients make informed decisions
Work with UK&I business leaders and Risk Consulting & Analytics Solutions colleagues on model development
Learn about and support the use of Marsh analytics solutions for Marsh Specialty clients
Collaborate with colleagues across Marsh's global teams
Share ideas and learn from experienced team members
Deliver accurate, high-quality work and contribute to positive client relationships
What you need to have:
An interest in actuarial work, insurance, risk management, and data analysis
A degree or relevant experience in mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, engineering, or a related subject
An interest in developing actuarial and analytical skills
An interest in General Insurance and the London insurance market
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
Some experience with, or a willingness to learn, a programming language such as Python or R
Good communication and presentation skills
The ability to work well as part of a team
A willingness to learn and develop your technical and consulting skills
Strong attention to detail and an organised approach to work
What makes you stand out:
Experience using Python, R, or another programming language
Progress towards, or an interest in completing, IFoA exams
Previous experience in insurance, actuarial work, risk management, data analysis, or consulting
Familiarity with catastrophe modelling or capital modelling
An understanding of Solvency II or other insurance regulatory frameworks
Knowledge of Lloyd's or the London Market
Experience presenting analysis or working with clients
Previous placement, internship, or early-career experience in a relevant field
Why join our team?
Work with a diverse, global client base as part of one of the world's leading insurance brokers
Gain experience across pricing, digital tool development, risk modelling, and analytics
Join a structured early-careers development programme alongside other new joiners, with dedicated mentoring and study support
Receive competitive actuarial study support
Develop your technical, analytical, and consulting skills
Benefit from clear opportunities to grow your career within a leading global organisation
Make a meaningful contribution to client projects from the start of your career
#Hybrid
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age background, civil partnership status, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments in accordance with applicable law to any candidate with a disability to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. If you have a disability that may require reasonable adjustments, please contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.
